tools.name: wavepay_register
tools.description: Register a WavePay merchant account. Returns a live merchant key (key) and a test-mode key (testKey) once — save both; only their hashes are stored. Free tier: 25 payments per 30 days; test mode is uncapped and never reaches a provider.

tools.name: wavepay_providers
tools.description: List the payment rails this deployment can take — PayNow (EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari, ZimSwitch, cards) and PayPal.

tools.name: wavepay_pricing
tools.description: Live plans and prices for a product, per rail, with the active promotion.

tools.name: wavepay_checkout
tools.description: Start a checkout for a product/plan on a rail; returns the hosted checkoutUrl to hand the buyer.

tools.name: wavepay_checkout_status
tools.description: Poll a payment by reference: pending | collected | expired.

tools.name: wavepay_features
tools.description: Which flagged capabilities (refunds, recurring, bnpl, card_tokens, paypal_billing, disputes) this deployment has switched on for live money. Test-mode keys can use every one.

tools.name: wavepay_subscribe
tools.description: Open a subscription for a customer (needs a merchant key; a mk_test_ key previews it with fake money). collection=automatic charges a saved card or PayPal subscription; invoice_and_remind (default, and the only mode for mobile wallets) sends a payment request each period. Returns the first checkout

tools.name: wavepay_bnpl
tools.description: Buy now, pay later: take a deposit now and collect the rest from the buyer's card on a schedule until the total is paid. Cards only (provider paynow or paypal); prepaid and virtual cards are refused. Needs a merchant key; mk_test_ previews it.

tools.name: wavepay_refund
tools.description: Refund a settled payment through its provider (PayPal; test payments with a test key). PayNow documents no refund API, so a PayNow payment is refused with REFUND_UNSUPPORTED rather than recorded as refunded. Needs a merchant key.

tools.name: wavepay_test_billing_run
tools.description: Test mode only (mk_test_ key): run the billing engine as if advanceDays had passed, so renewals, instalments and dunning can be exercised without waiting.

tools.name: wavepay_catalog
tools.description: Merchant self-service catalog — the sites, plans, prices and coupons your merchant key can see. Requires the x-wavepay-service-key header carrying an mk_live_… or mk_test_… key.
